Have fun!

notes.title: Game Update!
notes.content:
Game rewards balance.
Changed killing achievements requirements from 5k,15k,30k to 4k,8k,12k.
Fast forward from button (or space) changed from x2.5 speed to x3.0 speed.
Game speed can still be controlled from (f1, f2, f3, f4).
Bug fixing.

Have fun!

notes.title: Change game speed with F1, F2, F3 and F4
notes.content:
You can now change the game speed with F1 (1x speed), F2 (2x speed), F3 (3x speed) and F4 (5x speed).
Also updated the Unity engine version and minor bug fixes.
Have fun!
